author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52024 added another set of dictionaries that contained `reco::Track and `TrackingParticle` in their template arguments, which made the `duplicateReflexLibrarySearch.py` to complain misplaced dictionaries. The `SimDataFormats/Associations` is the correct place, so this PR generalizes the regex in the script to include any pair of `reco::Track` and `TrackingParticle`.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52082
Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2453

#### PR validation:

Running the update script locally no longer complains misplaced dictionaries.
title: Generalize Track-TrackingParticle association regex in `duplicateReflexLibrarySearch.py`
